interpretation_rules: Never compare PDMS and EPDMS as if they were identical.
Do not compare adapted Bench2Drive-220 results to full leaderboard results without matching routes, inputs, permitted data, controllers, and deployment rules.
Do not compare HUGSIM public aggregator results with paper zero-shot scores until split and evaluation scope match.
Keep world-model prediction, planner score, closed-loop driving, multi-agent realism, and decision-quality evidence as separate tracks.
Bench2Drive 0.0.3 rows are self-reported results copied from papers and vary by data, expert, training and inference compute; ground-truth-perception rows are privileged and must be separated.
Do not treat the 90.2 DriveVLA-W0 one-camera PDMS row and its separate dagger-marked 93.0 entry as the same configuration.
PlanWAM and World4Scorer both use K=64 candidate configurations; the EGCI selector reproduction ladder must include K=64 and charge generation, scoring, continuation and replay costs separately.

ReWAM is an existing reciprocal-response architecture; EGCI must not claim to invent reciprocal planning. Its contribution is independently verifiable execution, support-qualified counterfactual evaluation and evidence-audited decision quality.
